name: B P PODDAR HOSPITAL
description: B.P. Poddar Hospital & Medical Research Ltd. is one of the leading hospitals in Eastern India. It is a 205 bedded multi specialty hospital with a built-up area of 160000 sq. ft. The Hospital is running 6 Operation Theatres that have a state of art outdoor and indoor facility. The Hospital is equipped with MRI, CT Scan, Colour Doppler, Pathology Labs, ICCU, ITU, ICU, Step Down Unit, Wards, and Research facilities with the world’s most advance medical technologies. Our expert team of renowned consultants and dedicated staff members strive to cure the patients from a wide range of medical conditions. The hospital is also carrying out Nephrology treatment which includes, Dialysis and Kidney Transplantation. The other areas of specialization are cardiology (invasive & non-invasive), clinical research, gastroenterology, general and laparoscopic surgery, gynecology and obstetrics, medical & surgical oncology, neurology, NICU, SCBU & pediatrics, orthopedics and neo -natal care units. It is the first private hospital across India to have a Full Field Digital Mammography Machine after Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. The Hospital is expanding the capacity from 205 to 300 beds. We will soon be proud that a multi-specialty hospital in West Bengal will have the radiation facilities, which includes a Linear Accelerator and Brachytherapy.
